errors.text_span: а дясната, със стойности от 0,00 до 3,00, е използвана за дяла на купувачите в проценти. Двете скали са линейни и са маркирани с единици, като лявата ос показва стойности в милиарди (млрд.), а дясната – в проценти (%).
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a right-hand Y-axis. The description hallucinates its existence, range, and unit (%). The percentages shown are data labels on a line, not a series plotted against a separate axis.

errors.text_span: Втората линия, означена с оранжево, показва дяла на интернет купувачите в проценти.
errors.evidence: The chart does not show two separate plots. It shows a single dataset (number of buyers) as a blue area chart. The orange line is simply the top border of this area. The percentages are labels on this line representing year-over-year growth, not a separately plotted second line.

errors.text_span: показва дяла на интернет купувачите в проценти
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the percentage values as 'дял' (share). The values represent the year-over-year percentage growth of internet buyers, not their share of a total.
The description incorrectly states that the percentage values for the orange line continue to grow. The values actually decrease from 7.8% (2018) to 4.4% (2021) before rising again.

The description incorrectly associates the value 7.8% with the year 2017. In the chart, the 7.8% label is placed between 2017 and 2018 and represents the percentage growth in 2018. There is no percentage value given for 2017. This error is repeated for all subsequent percentage values and their associated years.

The description incorrectly lists the percentage value for 2022 as 8.4% twice, assigning it to both 2021 and 2022. The chart shows the value associated with 2021 is 4.4%, and the value for 2022 is 8.4%.
The description states that the orange line has orange markers, but the line is solid without any distinct markers (like circles, squares, etc.).

The description refers to the blue data series as a 'линия' (line), but it is depicted as a filled area chart. While it has a line at its top, calling it just a line is an inaccurate structural description.
